video_title: Rajon Rondo REFUSES to Run Up the Score in AAU Basketball

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues AAU basketball is a kill-or-be-killed environment
quotes.excerpt: it's a kill or be killed type space.
quotes.quote: I'm telling Richard it's a kill or be killed type space. He's telling me that AAU basketball is not teaching. No, it's a difference. We're not far behind like people are trying to make it out to be, but I was telling him like, if you go to one of these national tournaments and you're in a heated battle, you're not going to pull back. You're going to keep applying pressure. There's no mercy rule in AAU.

quotes.speaker: Rajon Rondo
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajon Rondo explains his coaching philosophy for AAU teams
quotes.excerpt: I challenge my guys to do different things. I stop allowing fast break layups.
quotes.quote: When I get up 30, I challenge my guys to do different things. I stop allowing fast break layups, I work on execution, and then I maybe try different defensive schemes. I'm not going to just keep applying pressure and trying to beat you by 90 points. I do not do that. I want to teach my kids how to play the right way.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson critiques full-court pressing in youth basketball
quotes.excerpt: you're full court pressing for 48 minutes in nine-year-old basketball, 10-year-old basketball, eight-year-old basketball.
quotes.quote: Rondo, one of the things that I was referencing is even in the earlier ages. We were talking about eight, nine, 10 years old when kids are supposed to be learning, when kids are developing, and you get into these leagues and it's like, oh, they're winning by 50, they're winning by 70, and it's like you're full court pressing for 48 minutes in nine-year-old basketball, 10-year-old basketball, eight-year-old basketball. I understand when you get into that 12s, 13s, 14s, 15s, when you get into a higher level, I was talking about the early developmental teams where kids are going to practice.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins claims high school basketball is dying
quotes.excerpt: in my opinion high school basketball is dead.
quotes.quote: If you're talking about taking basketball to the next level, in my opinion high school basketball is dead. You see now so many people are transitioning, they're either at private schools. Nowadays the game has changed so much is that these kids are working out around the clock. These kids are not saying I'm going to school to learn Spanish or social studies. The game is global when we talk about basketball, you don't have time to fuck around.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins emphasizes the necessity of personal trainers for elite prospects
quotes.excerpt: there's not one player out there that's top rank that doesn't have a personal trainer.
quotes.quote: There's not one player out there that's top rank or that's in the conversation of being an elite athlete or have a bright future that doesn't have a personal trainer. A personal 101 trainer. The game is global when we talk about basketball, you don't have time to fuck around. Now, it's not one player out there that's top rank or that's in the conversation of being an elite athlete or have a bright future that doesn't have a personal trainer. A personal 101 trainer.
